notes.title: Demo Update!
notes.notes:
Demo Update:

19/05/2024

https://pbs.twimg.com/media/GN8Pvb5W0AArgLE?format=jpg&name=large

Patchnotes:

You no longer start with large scrolls (someone said they were a bit redundant)

The turn ends once you use an offensive spell

An exit button has been added to the combat scene in case you wish to flee! "Effective" will now show if you use an element on a monster that they're weak to

"resisted" will no longer appear, "immune" will still appear if the monster is immune to the element

Monsters can no longer miss (someone was confused when the would miss occasionally?)

A new Door meter has been added to indicate how many monsters you have to slay to escape!

You can choose to continue a battle by attacking the door

notes.title: Demo Update 2
notes.notes:
​Demo Update 2:
21/05/2024

https://pbs.twimg.com/media/GOIfRPbXsAAwV0V?format=jpg&name=large
Patchnotes:
[olist]
 Clicking exit on the battlescreen take you to dungeon select 
 Sound effect added for when items poof away in the chest scene 
 Iventory opens and closes to show the item being added 
 Medium dungeon should now unlock properly
 Level 1 mushroom HP reduced from 3 to 2
 The pool of items you can receive from the mystic is adjusted depending on dungeon difficulty
 Low level encounters appearing in level 3 dungeons fixed
 Monsters should no longer appear for a split-second prior to the door appearing
 The max number of each item you can hold is now fixed at 9
 Using the crystal ball now has a sound effect
[/olist]

notes.title: ​Release version devlog 2
notes.notes:
​Release version devlog 2:
11/05/2024

Rogue-like adventure map added:

https://pbs.twimg.com/media/GNU1_kgXUAAJUcy.jpg

Before: The imp would give you a random item from an infinite pool..

Now: You have an inventory of items (you start with a basic set of scrolls etc..) and any that you gain get added to your sack and the helper draws from them.. so eventually you'll get that item you know you have in there somewhere. ​

​https://pbs.twimg.com/media/GNU2AsXWMAANYkI.png

But where can you get these extra wands and tomes from? Well after combat monsters may drop them.. but also from chests:

https://pbs.twimg.com/media/GNU2BhzWQAA18mE.png

You can also purchase them from shops:

​https://pbs.twimg.com/media/GNU2CZYWcAAMTfk.jpg

notes.title: Steam Version Devlog 1.5
notes.notes:
Game genre changed to Turn-Based and Rogue-like!

https://pbs.twimg.com/media/GNFsXmzXUAAHWjo.jpg

Monsters can now miss! ^

6th Element added!
​
https://pbs.twimg.com/media/GNFshhdWwAEkwZm.jpg
​
A healing element (no staff as yet!)

Also the new defensive items (ring and amulet) you can see pictured are now working! They protect you from 1 or 3 points of damage from a specific element!

Imp now offers you 2 items to choose from!

https://pbs.twimg.com/media/GNFsihSXMAAnnTE.png
​
Monsters now have elemental melee attacks!

Item generation is now longer random, you in fact have a deck/sack that the game draws from:


https://pbs.twimg.com/media/GNFsjiBWMAAgh0V.png
